Shared registered/CPU/GPU --sleep checks now verify actual strict thresholds/duration, zero policy, CanSleep, policy/impulse wake, inactive intervals, quiet-clock replay and dynamic contact/joint groups with static-support separation. General geometry/CCD, portable networking and final native/performance acceptance remain open. General geometry/CCD/network/native/performance acceptance remains open. Shared registered/CPU/GPU --continuous-response now verifies actual primitive ray/shape stopping, discrete control, relative momentum, elastic remaining time, full frame impulse, filters, one callback/tick and full force duration. 128 reset/full-step/capture/restore cycles measure strict 0/0 owner/all-thread bytes. Registered explicit-space controls exercise custom annulus inner-wall rebounds and actual terminal numerical interval-budget failure.
